Adds an opt-in bundled 1Password agent-secrets broker with per-secret approval policy, SQLite grants and audit state, transcript redaction, CLI inspection commands, documentation, and tests.

PR surface: Source +1385, Tests +853, Docs +238, Config +21, Other +6. Total +2503 across 26 files.

target.title: feat(onepassword): optional 1Password secrets broker plugin
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Agents that need credentials (LLM API keys, deploy tokens) shell out to the 1Password CLI ad hoc today: no policy layer, no approval gate, no record of which agent read which secret or why, and fragile per-call `op` spawning that has caused real incidents (#56217 rate-limit exhaustion, #55459 daemon hangs). OpenClaw's SecretRef system covers config-time credentials only — resolution has no audit log, no approval hook, and deliberately no agent-facing tool.

Closes #105924.

## Why This Change Was Made

Adds an optional bundled `onepassword` plugin (inactive until `plugins.entries.onepassword.config` exists) that turns agent secret access into a governed, observable flow:

- One `onepassword` agent tool with flat actions: `list` (registered slugs + policy, never values) and `get` (slug + mandatory reason).
- Per-slug policy `auto` / `approve` / `deny` (config default `approve`). `approve` rides the existing plugin-approval pipeline via the `before_tool_call` `requireApproval` seam, so prompts render in the Control UI and as chat-channel Allow/Deny buttons with zero core changes. `allow-always` persists a TTL'd standing grant (target-fingerprinted; invalidated if the slug's item/vault/field config changes).
- Every access attempt audited to the shared SQLite plugin state (agent, session, tool call, slug, reason, outcome, closed error codes) + `openclaw onepassword status|audit` CLI.
- Service-account token read only from `<state>/credentials/onepassword/service-account-token` (0600 warning) — never from config, env inheritance, logs, or tool output.
- `op` invoked once per cache miss via `execFile` with minimal env and `--cache=false` (#55459); no retries by design (#56217); in-memory TTL cache that can never bypass a deny policy or expired grant.
- Successful `get` values are redacted from persisted transcripts via the `tool_result_persist` hook (model sees the value for the turn; the stored transcript keeps only slug/item/field metadata).

Curated-registry-only by design: the plugin never enumerates a vault, and only configured slugs resolve. Non-goals kept out of this PR: a 1Password SecretRef provider integration (vault-mirror) for config credentials, and native push/watch delivery for plugin approvals — both tracked as follow-ups in #105924.

## User Impact

Opt-in only; zero behavior change unless configured. Operators who enable it get promptless, policy-controlled agent secret access with a complete audit trail; approval prompts appear in the Control UI and connected chat channels. Docs: `docs/plugins/onepassword.md`.

## Evidence

- Focused tests: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/onepassword` → 5 files, 33 tests passed (policy matrix incl. allow-always grant TTL + fingerprint invalidation, session isolation of identical tool-call ids, cache-vs-deny, op arg construction incl. `--cache=false`, error taxonomy, token-file handling, CLI output value-free).
- Remote gate (Blacksmith Testbox, delegated `pnpm check:changed` on head b1588f07f79): all lanes green including `typecheck all` and Plugin SDK API baseline (`OK`), exit 0. Earlier failures were pre-existing qa-lab typecheck breakage on the stale base (fixed by rebasing onto main, which carries #106037/#106061) and the intentional SDK-baseline hash change from adding a bundled plugin (regenerated via `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:gen`).
- Autoreview (Codex `gpt-5.6-sol`, xhigh, branch vs origin/main): one P1 finding, rejected as factually incorrect — it claimed `OpenKeyedStoreOptions` lacks `overflowPolicy`; the property exists on current `main` (`src/plugin-state/plugin-state-store.types.ts:48`) and the remote typecheck the finding predicted would fail passes on this head.
- Manifest JSON + labeler + docs nav/inventory generators run; `git diff --check` clean.
